mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates compress discount rates applied to equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 8.0% indicate weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate strengthening consumer demand that boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and rising RSAFS fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production signals reduced manufacturing output that lowers corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO is declining (3-month change < 0), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth rate (annualized) is above 2%, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation exceeding 228.0 on the CPI index signals potential monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 228.0, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent employment growth and unemployment decline indicate a strengthening labor market that enhances consumer spending power and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts signal improving residential construction activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST is rising (3-month change > 0), SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
